title: Small Business Usage History as the Annual kWh of Pre-Supply C&I Damages
content:
## Termination before supply: annual kWh from the small business agreement on the premise (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts)

The annual kWh of a termination before supply come from the Beacon Ridge small business electricity agreement, under Small Business Electricity Supply, on the same premise when that agreement has billing history: 12 or more energy charge lines posted on it in the twelve months before the handling date give the kWh of those lines; 3 up to 11 such lines give their kWh divided by their count, multiplied by 12; fewer lines, or no small business agreement on the premise, give the structure's minimum annual usage.

The records read are the Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on the premise of the terminated C&I contract and the energy charge lines on its bill, with their kWh and posted dates. A line falls in the twelve months before the handling date when it was posted on or before the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from its posted date to the handling date.

| Energy charge lines on the small business agreement in the twelve months | Annual kWh |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | the kWh of those lines |
| 3 to 11 | the kWh of those lines divided by their count, multiplied by 12 |
| 0 to 2, or no small business agreement on the premise | the structure's minimum annual usage |

| Structure | Minimum annual usage |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | 300001 kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | 300001 kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | 300001 kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | 300001 kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | 300001 kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | 300001 kWh |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- 12 lines totalling 845200 kWh: annual kWh 845200.
- 7 lines totalling 410900 kWh: 410900 divided by 7 is 58700, multiplied by 12 gives 704400.
- 2 lines, or no small business agreement on the premise: 300001.
